name: toque-marketplace
description: Developer toolkit for codebase auditing, AI-readiness scanning, structured planning, and operational readiness. Three plugins, one lockstep release. Works on any stack.

plugins.name: toque
plugins.description: Six-stage AI-Native SDLC planning (intent.md, spec.md, plan.md, review.md) with an adversarial verifier-first design gate, plan-linked troubleshooting, and documentation generation.

plugins.name: toque-readiness
plugins.description: AI-readiness scanning: 52 checks, 9 categories, composite letter grade, generated scaffolding for the gaps.

plugins.name: toque-audit
plugins.description: Severity-graded codebase audits, security scans, delta/KPI tracking, characterization tests, generated CI gates.
